notes: The repo has no git history, so I identified the step-7 tests from the schema and !literal decisions (38–42); they are test_remote.py:110–200. None of these names overclaims, and three are specific (literal tag read as literal, schema URI strings are literals, schema applies to included values). test_schema_validation is vague, since its body checks exit 4 for a violating file, exit 3 for a violating set, and exit 4 for bad or invalid schemas. test_set_include_like_string_is_written_literal names less than its body checks: it also tests --include converting to an include, dropping the tag, and refusing missing includes.
